findings.title: Organization review workflow preserves the documented artifact-only boundary
findings.observation: At the inspected revision the only trigger is workflow_dispatch, top-level permissions are contents:read and actions:read, and the review job is restricted to this repository, manual events and refs/heads/main. Its action steps contain no Pages upload or deployment action. The organization-home guide explicitly documents these same boundaries.
findings.why_it_matters: A retained review artifact can exercise the organization evidence path without silently activating a second publisher or changing the canonical host.
findings.recommendation: Preserve this boundary while exercising the real artifact path. Resolve the separately proposed host transition and publication acceptance through their existing owners.
suggested_validation: Execute one supported real report through the repository model and retained organization review artifact.
Qualify artifact transport, failure behavior, canonical hosting and recovery separately before publication.
missing_evidence: No workflow dispatch, artifact download, application execution, live hosting or recovery was assessed in this source-only audit.

evidence.summary: Exact Git workflow blob was read and parsed with YAML BaseLoader; manual trigger, read permissions, main guard and absence of Pages action steps were inspected.
Exact Git guide blob explicitly documents the matching review-only permissions, manual/main scope and unqualified intended hosting target.

limitations: Only the two named source files and the stated workflow/documentation expectation were assessed; this is a partial contract-drift audit, not whole-repository conformance.
